answer_sentences.text: The FAQ does not specify any foreclosure charge.
answer_sentences.quote: Interest is charged at the rate applicable on the date of the loan and is calculated on the daily balance.

answer_sentences.text: For unpaid loans after maturity, it says the Bank may sell the ornaments by public auction to recover its dues.
answer_sentences.quote: If the loan remains unpaid after maturity, the Bank may sell the ornaments by public auction to recover its dues.
